# laravelforge_site_environment (Data Source)

Fetches the `.env` file contents of a Laravel Forge site (singleton per site).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose environment is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) The current `.env` file contents as returned by Forge.
